mapper.select:
SELECT MIN(bm) AS bm, bmsm, MIN(pym) AS pym, MIN(qtdm) AS qtdm, MIN(xssx) AS xssx, MIN(whonet) AS whonet, MIN(his_bmdm) AS his_bmdm, MIN(rqdm) AS rqdm, MIN(rqlx) AS rqlx, MIN(cjyq) AS cjyq FROM sys_bbzl_dict WHERE 1=1
AND (bmsm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR pym LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR qtdm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
GROUP BY bmsm ORDER BY CASE WHEN MIN(xssx) IS NULL OR MIN(xssx) = 0 THEN 9999 ELSE MIN(xssx) END, MIN(pym)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_bbzl_dict (bmsm, pym, qtdm, xssx, whonet, his_bmdm, rqdm, rqlx, cjyq) VALUES (#{bmsm}, #{pym}, #{qtdm}, #{xssx}, #{whonet}, #{hisBmdm}, #{rqdm}, #{rqlx}, #{cjyq})
